name: Denazinosuchus
sum: Denazinosuchus is a goniopholidid mesoeucrocodylian from the Late Cretaceous Fruitland and Kirtland formations of the San Juan Basin, New Mexico.
wsnote: The sources consulted do not give the body length.
holotype: Catalogue number not given in the sources consulted.
material: Remains from the Kirtland and Fruitland formations; first named as Goniopholis kirtlandicus by Wiman (1932).
biology: The sources consulted give no evidence of diet or habits.
author: Lucas and Sullivan 2003
